Record.heading: Track record
Record.intro: Every pick we publish is graded after the game. Wins, losses and ties all count, and nothing is ever removed.
Record.noGraded: No graded picks yet. The first results appear after this week's games are final.
Record.brierHelp: Average squared gap between the probability and the result (0 is perfect, always saying 50% scores 0.25). Lower is better.
Record.calibrationHelp: When the model says 70%, the pick should win about 70% of the time. Each row compares the average predicted probability with how often those picks actually won.
Record.atsUnavailable: Not tracked: EndzoneIQ doesn't use betting lines. This appears only if market lines are ever enabled.
Record.chainHelp: Each pick is hashed together with the previous pick's hash. Changing any past pick would change every hash after it, so this value proves the record hasn't been rewritten.
